component.name: PasteFlow
component.summary: Native Linux clipboard manager with smart recognition and Paste Queue

description.p: PasteFlow is a fast, local-only GTK4 clipboard manager designed for Linux Mint Cinnamon (X11). It captures text, code, links, colors, images, and file lists with zero polling, instant FTS5 trigram search, custom Spaces, a sequential Paste Queue, and memory-only storage for sensitive clips.
